summary: Cred and Duck discuss the strong BTC range reclaim above 90k with weekly resistance at 104k. They view the TA as quite bullish across all timeframes, with Duck holding a long position. ETH had a significant breakout above 2k (up 60-80% from lows) but Duck is still underwater from his 2.7k entry. Both hosts emphasize ETH must hold 2k-2.2k for the move to be credible. They remain skeptical about a traditional alt season due to extreme dispersion, with too many coins diluting capital. Individual picks include XRP (Duck holding from 0.5), HYPE (fundamentally sound), and PEPE (ETH-correlated meme). They warn that over-leveraged macro tourists got blown out in record liquidations.
key_takeaways: BTC weekly range reclaim above 90k is very bullish - 90k line in the sand, anything below invalidates thesis
ETH breakout needs to hold 2k-2.2k for continuation - failure would be devastating for altcoins given increased positioning
Alt season unlikely in traditional sense - too many coins, dispersion too extreme, need to be very selective
Record short liquidations around 103k as shorts got blown out on the move up
Duck holds BTC long, ETH from 2.7k (still underwater), and XRP from 0.5
